result.reason: The clause adds the required IP, breach-of-law, Vendor-caused data incident, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct subjects, but it does not require TrueLink to defend claims and includes no notice, control-of-defense, or cooperation procedure. Several triggers are framed as an “allegation” or event rather than a third-party claim, making the indemnity broader than necessary. The language is also grammatically defective (“any (i) any claim”) and retains a duplicated “harmless.” It otherwise preserves the original Vendor indemnity and unrelated commercial intent.
